headline: Oil Rebounds Toward $100 as Democrats Win Control of Congress
summary: Oil prices reversed recent declines, with Brent crude rising 4.0% to $98.38 per barrel and WTI gaining 2.9% to $90.65. The rebound followed Democrats sweeping control of both the House and Senate.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity and energy benchmark, with price movements directly affecting energy sector equities, inflation expectations, and transportation costs worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Brent crude prices rose by 4.0% following political developments in the United States.
